scheme_name: Silicosis Pidit Hita-dhikariyon Hetu Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Must be a construction worker registered with the Board as a beneficiary and depositing contributions.
Must be certified as suffering from silicosis by the Pneumoconiosis Medical Board under the Rajasthan Workmen's Compensation (Occupational Diseases) Rules, 1965.
Must not have received silicosis assistance from the Rajasthan Environment and Health Care Fund.
Assistance can be claimed only under one of the schemes of the Rajasthan Environment and Health Cess Fund or the Board.
Application must be made within 6 months of issuance of the medical certificate or, in case of death, within 6 months of death (extensions possible with Divisional Secretary approval).
benefits_summary: Provides ₹1,00,000 financial assistance to silicosis patients and ₹3,00,000 to families in case of death.
